policy: Existing typed graph projection; raw kinds retained. No edge is promoted to a proved implication or compatible interface.

scoped_relations.relation_coverage: Named exact interfaces only; topical adjacency is not a logical dependency.

evidence.range_scope: Preserved source or internally derived evidence; external correctness and priority UNKNOWN.

requires_external_validation.scope: Measure time-resolved mixed-isotope inventories and hazards under calibrated potentials/temperature, including isotope exchange, side reactions and loading selectivity. First test the0.10-to0.95/half-D target with complete isotope mass balance, then independently measure recovered-product purity/yield, collector dilution, net full-cycle energy, cycle time, accessible area and endurance against the strongest matched isotope separator. Complete priority review before a novelty claim.
